title: Validation: solution
description: The solution sub-score (EE-026), at <venture>/purpose/validation/solution.json: how the venture solves the problem, what people use instead, and cited evidence that people in the segment choose it over their current way.

statement.description: How it solves the problem, in one or two sentences

product.description: Product id, if one product carries the solution

alternatives.description: What people use instead today, including doing nothing

probability.description: The Jev probability for this sub-score; the evidence grade weighs it in the validation score
